description.text: Difficulty: Intermediate

long_description.text: A deceptively cute and deadly Yakuza enforcer, Kira-chan cares equally about killing her targets and looking adorable while doing so.

ru.original: A deceptively cute and deadly Yakuza enforcer, Kira-chan cares equally about killing her targets and looking adorable while doing so.
ru.translation: Красота бывает смертельно обманчива, и Kira-chan, — жестокая убийца из клана якудзы, — яркий тому пример. Она не просто убивает своих жертв, она делает это красиво.

es.original: A deceptively cute and deadly Yakuza enforcer, Kira-chan cares equally about killing her targets and looking adorable while doing so.
es.translation: Nunca creerías que alguien tan bonita y delicada podría ser miembro de la temible yakuza... Y es que ella nunca quiere perder su atractivo, ¡incluso cuando mata a sus enemigos!

de.original: A deceptively cute and deadly Yakuza enforcer, Kira-chan cares equally about killing her targets and looking adorable while doing so.
de.translation: Eine trügerisch niedliche, tödliche Vollstreckerin der Yakuza. Kira-chan macht ihren ahnungslosen Gegnern blitzschnell den Garaus.

pt.original: A deceptively cute and deadly Yakuza enforcer, Kira-chan cares equally about killing her targets and looking adorable while doing so.
pt.translation: Não se deixe enganar pela aparência fofa desta agente da Yakuza; Kira-chan é altamente fatal e foca tanto em matar seus inimigos quanto em fazê-lo da forma mais graciosa possível.

fr.original: A deceptively cute and deadly Yakuza enforcer, Kira-chan cares equally about killing her targets and looking adorable while doing so.
fr.translation: Yakuza impitoyable au charme trompeur, Kira-chan n'a qu'un seul objectif : tuer ses cibles tout en gardant son look kawaii.

description.text: Kira-chan thrives on defeating opponents, regenerating health and becoming resistant to damage for a short time whenever she kills an enemy Hero.

ru.original: Kira-chan thrives on defeating opponents, regenerating health and becoming resistant to damage for a short time whenever she kills an enemy Hero.
ru.translation: Чем больше врагов убьет Kira-chan, тем лучше для нее. Стоит ей убить вражеского героя, как ее раны тут же начнут заживать. Кроме того, она ненадолго становится бессмертной.

es.original: Kira-chan thrives on defeating opponents, regenerating health and becoming resistant to damage for a short time whenever she kills an enemy Hero.
es.translation: Kira-Chan regenera su salud y se vuelve resistente al daño por un breve período cada vez que mata a un rival.

de.original: Kira-chan thrives on defeating opponents, regenerating health and becoming resistant to damage for a short time whenever she kills an enemy Hero.
de.translation: Kira-chan geht im Kampf richtig auf. Wann immer sie einen Gegner tötet, regeneriert sie Gesundheit und wird für kurze Zeit immun gegenüber Schaden.

pt.original: Kira-chan thrives on defeating opponents, regenerating health and becoming resistant to damage for a short time whenever she kills an enemy Hero.
pt.translation: Kira-chan sabe bem como derrotar seus oponentes, regenerando pontos e vida e se tornando resistente a danos por um curto período sempre que mata um herói inimigo.

fr.original: Kira-chan thrives on defeating opponents, regenerating health and becoming resistant to damage for a short time whenever she kills an enemy Hero.
fr.translation: Kira-chan est une tueuse née. Elle récupère des points de vie et résiste aux dégâts pendant un court laps de temps dès qu'elle tue un ennemi.

description.text: Turns any firefight into a music video, granting Kira unlimited ammo for her weapons for a short duration. Nearby allies also gain a boost to reload speed while the effect lasts.

ru.original: Turns any firefight into a music video, granting Kira unlimited ammo for her weapons for a short duration. Nearby allies also gain a boost to reload speed while the effect lasts.
ru.translation: Если Kira нужно сделать передышку и ненадолго получить неиссякаемый боекомплект, она превращает бой в музыкальный видеоклип. Если в это время рядом будут ее товарищи, они смогут быстро перезарядить оружие.

es.original: Turns any firefight into a music video, granting Kira unlimited ammo for her weapons for a short duration. Nearby allies also gain a boost to reload speed while the effect lasts.
es.translation: Kira convierte las peleas en videoclips musicales y recibe munición ilimitada por un breve período. Los aliados cercanos recargan sus armas más rápido mientras dura el efecto.

de.original: Turns any firefight into a music video, granting Kira unlimited ammo for her weapons for a short duration. Nearby allies also gain a boost to reload speed while the effect lasts.
de.translation: Verwandelt jeden Kampf in ein Musikvideo und Kira erhält für kurze Zeit unbegrenzte Munitionsvorräte. Nahe Verbündete können in dieser Zeit schneller nachladen.

pt.original: Turns any firefight into a music video, granting Kira unlimited ammo for her weapons for a short duration. Nearby allies also gain a boost to reload speed while the effect lasts.
pt.translation: Transforma qualquer troca de tiros em clipe de música e proporciona a Kira munição ilimitada para suas armas por um curto período. Os aliados próximos também recebem um aumento na velocidade de recarregamento de suas armas enquanto o efeito durar.

fr.original: Turns any firefight into a music video, granting Kira unlimited ammo for her weapons for a short duration. Nearby allies also gain a boost to reload speed while the effect lasts.
fr.translation: Transforme les combats en clip vidéo, et confère à Kira des munitions illimitées pendant un court laps de temps. Confère également un effet de rechargement plus rapide à ses alliés à proximité.

description.text: Difficulty: Intermediate

long_description.text: Unfit heir to the Throne, Trondson has been a Sons of Law & Order biker prospect for 50 years, learning the ropes of becoming a real dwarf. Trondson excels at mechanics and high precision work. He even builds his own digging tools and weapons, offering unexpected tricks on both offense and defense.

ru.original: Unfit heir to the Throne, Trondson has been a Sons of Law & Order biker prospect for 50 years, learning the ropes of becoming a real dwarf. Trondson excels at mechanics and high precision work. He even builds his own digging tools and weapons, offering unexpected tricks on both offense and defense.
ru.translation: Trondson, неугодный наследник трона, полвека был надеждой банды байкеров «Сыновья закона и порядка», и во всех подробностях изучил, что значит быть настоящим гномом. Trondson превосходен в работе, которая требует точности, и в механике. Он сам делает инструменты и оружие, изобретая неожиданные трюки, связанные как с атакой, так и с защитой.

es.original: Unfit heir to the Throne, Trondson has been a Sons of Law & Order biker prospect for 50 years, learning the ropes of becoming a real dwarf. Trondson excels at mechanics and high precision work. He even builds his own digging tools and weapons, offering unexpected tricks on both offense and defense.
es.translation: Trondson es el miembro más joven de una dinastía de enanos vikingos motoqueros. Se especializa en trabajos mecánicos y de precisión y puede resultar un gran aliado tanto en ataque como en defensa.

de.original: Unfit heir to the Throne, Trondson has been a Sons of Law & Order biker prospect for 50 years, learning the ropes of becoming a real dwarf. Trondson excels at mechanics and high precision work. He even builds his own digging tools and weapons, offering unexpected tricks on both offense and defense.
de.translation: Als unwürdiger Erbfolger des Throns ist Trondson schon seit 50 Jahren Anwerber der Bikergang Sons of Law & Order und lernt, wie man ein richtiger Zwerg wird. Trondson glänzt vor allem mit Präzision und Handwerkswissen. Er baut seine eigenen Werkzeuge und Waffen und hat ein paar unerwartete Tricks für die Offensive und Defensive auf Lager.

pt.original: Unfit heir to the Throne, Trondson has been a Sons of Law & Order biker prospect for 50 years, learning the ropes of becoming a real dwarf. Trondson excels at mechanics and high precision work. He even builds his own digging tools and weapons, offering unexpected tricks on both offense and defense.
pt.translation: Um herdeiro inadequado para o trono, Trondson tem tentado fazer parte da gangue de motoqueiros Filhos da Lei e da Ordem há 50 anos, aprendendo os truques do ofício de um anão de verdade. Trondson é um expert em trabalhos de alta precisão e mecânica. Ele até mesmo constrói suas próprias ferramentas de escavação e armas, oferecendo truques inesperados tanto para ofensiva quanto defensiva.

fr.original: Unfit heir to the Throne, Trondson has been a Sons of Law & Order biker prospect for 50 years, learning the ropes of becoming a real dwarf. Trondson excels at mechanics and high precision work. He even builds his own digging tools and weapons, offering unexpected tricks on both offense and defense.
fr.translation: Héritier écarté du trône, Trondson est un membre emblématique du club de bikers Sons of Law & Order depuis 50 ans : c'est là qu'il apprend ce que c'est d'être un nain, un vrai. Trondson excelle dans le travail de précision et en mécanique. Il a conçu ses propres outils et armes, et a plus d'un tour dans son sac en attaque et défense.

de.translation: Hier geht es Schlag auf Schlag!

fr.translation: Qui c'est les plus forts ? Les nains !

description.text: Trondson crawls more quickly than other Heroes when he's crouched.

ru.original: Trondson crawls more quickly than other Heroes when he's crouched.
ru.translation: В приседе Trondson ползает быстрее прочих героев.

es.original: Trondson crawls more quickly than other Heroes when he's crouched.
es.translation: Al agacharse, Trondson avanza más rápido que los demás personajes.

de.original: Trondson crawls more quickly than other Heroes when he's crouched.
de.translation: Trondson kriecht schneller als alle anderen Helden, wenn er sich duckt.

pt.original: Trondson crawls more quickly than other Heroes when he's crouched.
pt.translation: Trondson engatinha mais rápido do que os outros heróis quando se agacha.

fr.original: Trondson crawls more quickly than other Heroes when he's crouched.
fr.translation: Trondson se déplace plus rapidement que tous les autres héros lorsqu'il rampe.

description.text: Trondson and nearby teammates deal more damage when digging through Blocks.

ru.original: Trondson and nearby teammates deal more damage when digging through Blocks.
ru.translation: Trondson и участники команды рядом с ним наносят больше урона, когда копают сквозь блоки.

es.original: Trondson and nearby teammates deal more damage when digging through Blocks.
es.translation: Trondson y sus compañeros de equipo cercanos provocan más daño al romper cubos.

de.original: Trondson and nearby teammates deal more damage when digging through Blocks.
de.translation: Trondson und nahe Teamkollegen richten mehr Schaden an, wenn sie sich durch Blöcke graben.

pt.original: Trondson and nearby teammates deal more damage when digging through Blocks.
pt.translation: Trondson e companheiros de equipe por perto causam mais dano ao escavar blocos.

fr.original: Trondson and nearby teammates deal more damage when digging through Blocks.
fr.translation: Trondson et ses coéquipiers à proximité infligent davantage de dégâts lorsqu'ils détruisent des blocs.
